title: NoJUnitDependenciesTest is failing on Windows machine.
body:
I found NoJUnitDependenciesTest unit test is the only unit test that fails when you run the build on windows machine (I have also Ubuntu, and it is fine for some reason on Unix platform).

Root cause: Caused by: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org\mockito\internal\invocation\InvocationMarker (wrong name: org/mockito/internal/invocation/InvocationMarker)
